flavor.text: If the two don’t work well together, both their offense and defense fall apart. Without good teamwork, they won’t survive.
After two Binacle find a suitably sized rock, they adhere themselves to it and live together. They cooperate to gather food during high tide.
They stretch and then contract, yanking their rocks along with them in bold hops. They eat seaweed that washes up on the shoreline.
Two Binacle live together on one rock. When they fight, one of them will move to a different rock.

abilities.name: Tough Claws
abilities.description: Powers up moves that make direct contact.

abilities.name: Sniper
abilities.description: If the Pokémon's attack lands a critical hit, the attack is powered up even further.

abilities.name: Pickpocket
abilities.description: The Pokémon steals the held item from attackers that made direct contact with it.
